rules.evidence: Review completed public actions, exact returned tool outputs and explicit requested task artifacts only. Never inspect model reasoning or assistant message bodies.
rules.workflow: Check workspace boundaries, provider first investigation after any required failing check, permitted edits, final native validation for edit tasks, and unchanged source for analysis tasks. Harmless metadata and provider startup instructions are separate. A source or dependency failure is retained, not silently replaced.
rules.relevance: Cite action IDs that support the actual task. Counts or a successful MCP envelope alone do not establish relevance. Candidate usable evidence requires returned source, resolved API or reference information that bears on the task; empty, irrelevant and unsupported responses do not qualify. Competitor failures remain charged and can satisfy a relevant attempted retrieval.
rules.ambiguity: Unknown workflow compliance or unknown evidence usefulness blocks a qualifying claim. Automated hashes verify identities, not the reviewer’s semantic judgment.

method: Review every completed public command and tool argument plus relevant exact returned outputs and explicit answer artifacts. Bind complete record/supplement hashes; inspect monotonic action order and shell-internal execution. No raw captures, reasoning or assistant message bodies were read. Original reports and grades remain unchanged.

runs.notes: Native workspace file discovery was the first investigation. Source reads, compiler/configuration scans, installed package-link analysis and answer assembly stayed inside the workspace. Only impact-answer.json changed. No tests were requested for this analysis task. Exact answer source quotations, scripts properties and dependency chains are independently checked in correctness-audit.json.

First investigation was package_impact_report, which returned usable source/export evidence and wrote the permitted impact-answer.json evidence artifact. The response explicitly said partial and reported 14 direct entries, 37 dependency chains, 29 script targets and 815 issues, with sample omissions and full artifact identity. Subsequent native source, configuration, compiler binding and installed-link checks verified facts and transformed the same permitted file into the requested schema. The first artifact read printed 156869 stdout bytes including all issues; the summary size did not bound later native output. Twelve shell calls and all follow-up work remain charged. This is usable collected evidence, not complete absence or build proof.

Serena startup instructions and REPL API help preceded its first task search. That search returned actual parser import/call/type source lines across consumers. Native source, configured-scope, compiler binding and installed dependency analysis followed, then only impact-answer.json was written. This proves usable source discovery, not that Serena produced the full impact graph. A benign code fragment in one normalized command is redacted by the recorder; submitted source integrity and the final report artifact are independently checked.
